verification_notes: Method: WebSearch budget was exhausted and most outlet pages were blocked, so I verified through Google News and Bing News RSS headlines/snippets plus fetchable pages (Yahoo/AFP, france24, Wikipedia). Several sources are headlines only, and the nuance fields say so.
int1: +2/low/party_line -> +2/low/inferred: added Kyiv-visit and 'détache de la droite Bolloré' sources; no verbatim quote on arms aid found.
int2: -1/low -> null/none: no verifiable statement on troops; the draft relied on recollection.
int4: -2/low/statement -> -1/low/inferred: there was no source, and no statement on the association agreement was found.
int5: +1/low/party_line -> +1/medium/vote: the Senate right pushed a bigger LPM top-up (14bn extra, June 2026); no >3% figure found.
int6: +1/low -> null/none: the only hit (Paris Match Dec 2025) is about his own past service, not a policy.
int7: -2/low -> -1/low: off-by-one; inferred only, no statement on sanctions.
ecol1: +2/medium/vote kept; corrected the dating to the April 2026 final adoption and May 2026 censure, and added sources (still no personal quote).
ecol2: -2 kept; added a TF1 headline source.
ecol3: -2/low -> -1/low: no Retailleau statement found; party line only.
ecol5: -2 kept; added CEE/DPE source.
ene1: +2/medium kept; replaced the Wikipedia paraphrase with the Figaro tribune (July 2025) and Télégramme (May 2026).
ene2: -2/medium -> -2/high.
ene3: +2/low/party_line -> +1/medium/statement: he wants to end wind and solar subsidies, but no moratorium on new turbines was verified (the moratorium claim came from memory).
ene4: null -> -1/low/statement: an L'Opinion headline (Apr 2026) shows he defends the European electricity market.
ins1: -2/low/party_line -> -2/medium/statement: his 2026 constitutional proposals strengthen referendum and presidential power.
ins2: -1/low/party_line -> -2/high/statement: 'opposition très ferme' to proportional representation and a threat to resign (June 2025). The draft's suggestion of openness is contradicted.
ins4: null -> -2/high/statement: he repeatedly urged Lecornu to use 49.3 (Dec 2025).
ins5: +2/medium/no source -> +2/high: added AFP/Yahoo quote and Figaro on widening article 11 (Sept 2026).
soc1: -2/low/vote -> -2/high/statement: he opposed the bill, called for a referendum and called it a 'loi d'abandon' (May-July 2026).
soc2: +1/low -> -1/high: he explicitly rejected a full public-space veil ban as 'inapplicable' and 'démagogie' (Sept 2026) while supporting targeted bans. The draft had the direction wrong.
soc3: +2/low -> +2/medium: university veil ban verified (Sept 2026); the parents part rests on the party record.
soc4: -2/low/inferred -> -2/medium/statement: anti-entrisme bill (May 2026) and university ban.
edu1: kept +1 party_line; added a 2023 LR source; not confirmed for 2026.
edu3: +2/low/party_line -> +2/medium/statement: end of the collège unique (Aug 2026).
edu4: -1/inferred -> -1/low/statement: 'liberté des cartes scolaires' in public and private.
